identity.operation: Parse table cell boundaries and spoiler delimiters.
identity.condition: Table and spoiler parsing are enabled, with double pipes inside a table cell.
identity.capability: Preserve double pipes as spoiler delimiters while treating single pipes as cell boundaries.
identity.consequence: Table parsing consumes or misclassifies the spoiler delimiters inside the cell.

requirement: With table and spoiler parsing enabled, double pipe spoiler delimiters must remain available within a table cell while single pipes delimit cells.

assessment.necessity_reason: The old entry passes input-controlled parser flags and Markdown to md_html, which passes them to md_parse. A finite table input containing ||x|| can therefore use the after parser's table and spoiler paths. The table pass reserves single pipes for cell boundaries; normal processing of each cell resolves double pipes as spoiler spans.

before.requirement: Preserve double pipes as spoiler delimiters inside a table cell.
before.reason: The before collector makes pipe marks available as single-character table boundaries, and the complete before inline dispatch has no spoiler handling.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The before inline rendering dispatch has no pipe spoiler case.

after.requirement: With table and spoiler parsing enabled, preserve double pipes inside a cell as spoiler delimiters while single pipes delimit cells.
after.reason: The collector creates two-character spoiler marks before handling single pipes. The table pass selects only unresolved one-character pipes as boundaries. Each resulting cell runs normal inline processing, which pairs spoiler marks and emits spoiler spans.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Table row processing discovers boundaries and passes each cell to normal inline processing.
Normal inline processing analyzes two-character pipe marks when spoilers are enabled.
Resolved two-character pipe marks dispatch spoiler span callbacks.
md_html installs the HTML span callbacks in the parser.
md_html passes the supplied input and parser flags to md_parse.

assessment.comparison_reason: The frozen spoiler-in-table capability was unavailable before. After the change, the same old harness has a direct input route to it. This assessment is limited to claim o-c49a850503387666; it does not establish coverage of the other selected changes.

necessity_evidence.reason: The after source preserves double pipes during table boundary detection, then parses them as spoiler delimiters inside the resulting cell. The old harness can supply the parser flags and Markdown through md_html. The same capability was unavailable in the before source; the after source provides a route to it.
necessity_evidence.finite_witness: The first unsigned input value selects MD_FLAG_TABLES | MD_FLAG_SPOILERS, the second is zero, and the remaining bytes are `a|b\n-|-\n||x|| | z`. The first cell of the table body contains `||x||`.

scope_contract.reason: The entry calls md_html with input-controlled parser flags and Markdown. The after parser defines the frozen table-cell spoiler behavior.

evidence.dependency_reason: The entry supplies the parser flags and Markdown to md_html.

feasible_trigger.reason: A finite supported table-and-spoiler setup exists, but its route is not blocked: the entry passes the flags and text through md_html to md_parse.

evidence.dependency_reason: md_html installs the parser callbacks and uses the supplied parser flags.
md_html forwards the input and parser to md_parse.
The fuzzer controls both flag values and the Markdown bytes.

observable_consequence.reason: The after table pass selects only unresolved one-character pipes as boundaries. Cell processing can pair the preserved two-character marks and dispatch spoiler spans.

evidence.dependency_reason: Resolved double-pipe marks dispatch spoiler span callbacks.
The complete entry has no output assertion that could instead be invalidated.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: An equivalent route is present: table boundary discovery excludes double-pipe marks, and each resulting cell receives normal inline processing with spoiler handling.

evidence.dependency_reason: Each selected table cell runs normal block-content processing.
Table row processing discovers boundaries and passes cell ranges onward.
The spoiler handler pairs potential double-pipe opener and closer marks.
The unchanged entry supplies the required flags and text.

identity_preserved.reason: Both sides are assessed for the same tuple: spoiler delimiters inside a table cell. The before collector and table pass have no spoiler handling; the after source adds it and keeps a route through the same old harness.

evidence.dependency_reason: This is the fixed harness used for both source versions.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The md_html wrapper installs callbacks and forwards parser flags.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The recipe builds and links the md_html and md_parse libraries for this entry.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: With table and spoiler parsing enabled, `||x||` inside a table cell forms a spoiler span while single pipes delimit cells.
coverage_witness.required_setup: MD_FLAG_TABLES and MD_FLAG_SPOILERS, plus a valid pipe-delimited Markdown table containing `||x||` in a cell.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: The old entry reads parser flags from its input prefix and passes those flags and the remaining Markdown bytes to md_html.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: None established; the frozen behavior has a route through the old entry.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: md_html forwards the flags and text to md_parse; table boundary detection skips two-character spoiler marks, then normal cell inline processing resolves them.
